about.pitch: POLYFALL is a first-person, low-poly battle royale where movement replaces building. Drop onto a faceted, brightly coloured island, loot weapons and shields, and outmove everyone else. No building, no edits: positioning, cover and movement skill decide every fight.
facts: 24-40 per match, bots fill empty slots
Mid-range PCs at 60+ FPS, down to a GTX 1650 / Steam Deck on Low
pillars: Traversal is the skill ceiling. Every surface invites a slide, a vault or a climb.
Clean low-poly shapes and a strict palette make enemies, loot and cover easy to read.
Smaller lobbies, a fast storm and frequent fights.

cards.title: How a match works
items: Start on the **spawn island**, out at sea: practise your movement and pick where you want to drop on the map.
Walk through your own **shard portal** and step out at your spot on Shatter Isle.
**Loot** every building: open dressers, fridges and lockers; doors can be locked from inside or bashed open; windows break.
**Fight** and rotate ahead of the storm until one player is left.
**Quests** in every match and daily ones give account XP.

cards.title: The movement kit
items: **Sprint** and a **tactical sprint** burst across open ground.
**Slide** and **slide-hop**: jump out of a slide and land straight into the next.
**Mantle** ledges up to about 2 m, **hurdle** waist-high cover, **vault through windows**.
**Wall kick** for one extra jump, **lean** around corners, a quick **punch** when you're out of options.
Every character moves exactly the same: a skin is never an advantage.

cards.title: Health and shields
items: **150 health + 150 shield**, nothing hidden.
Shield comes from **Shards** you carry and crush: a small Shard (+25) in one hand while you keep shooting, a **Core Shard** (+50) with both hands.
Crushing is loud and visible: a teal burst and a glass crack others can hear.

cards.title: Weapons
items: Playable now: **Facet AR**, **Breaker** pump shotgun, **Hornet SMG** and the **Sidearm** everyone starts with.
Coming: a burst rifle, an auto shotgun, a sniper and a launcher.
Five rarities, Common to Legendary, a small damage step per tier; rifles and SMGs get an optic from Epic up.
21 weapon camos plus mastery camos: looks only.

cards.title: Shatter Isle
items: About 2 km across, with a crashed data core in the middle and eight regions around it.

**Core Crater** (hot drop) · **Vertex Village** (house-to-house) · **Prism Port** (desert docks) · **Glitch Mall** (indoor fights) · **Overclock Yards** (cranes and containers) · **Frostbyte Lodge** (ski slopes) · **Static Heights** (icy caves) · **Uncharted Land** (dense forest).
Every building has two or more ways in and a roof you can climb to.

cards.title: The story
items: **The Render** is a simulation built to preserve a dying world. A crash rebuilt it at minimum detail: the low-poly look.
Its last copies of people, the **Echoes**, fight in the Shatter Isle trials. The winner's data is saved; everyone else is reset.
Three factions: the **Wardens** (security programs), the **Fractured** (corrupted Echoes) and the **Drifters** (mercenaries).

cards.title: Characters
items: **Phantom**, a Warden scout with a hard-light data scarf, is playable in four colourways.
Coming: **Byte**, **Shard**, **Nomad**, **Glitch**, **Rook** and more.
Characters are cosmetic only; abilities come from the Assist Kit.

cards.title: Assist Kit, kept fair
items: Everyone brings **one active assist and one passive perk**, for example a short dash or faster mantling.
No damage, health, shield or accuracy boosts; long cooldowns; every ability has a visible tell and a counter.
Levelling unlocks choices and sidegrades, never more power.

cards.title: Modes
items: At launch: a **Solo Battle Royale** mode, and the **Range**, a training mode with targets, bots and drills.
Later: Duos and Trios, Zone Wars, a Zombies mode, more PvP modes and a story campaign.

cards.title: Promises
items: Built for PC first, tuned to run on modest hardware.
Community ideas are a priority and consistently kept up with.
Constant updates, new features, complete overhauls and more.
